mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks from -61.1 to -58.7, and this positive momentum persists as activity normalizes, producing a higher mean RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not greater than the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has recovered to -53.9, and when it stays above -55 for two consecutive weeks it signals resumed commuting that supports retail footfall, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT stays above -55 for two consecutive weeks but the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not greater than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES indicates reduced confinement and returning routines, which lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both above their t-3w values
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES are both above their t-3w values, the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime with transit recovery, TRANSIT improvement combined with RESIDENTIAL staying below 14.5 supports retail mobility, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: In the reopening with transit recovery regime, the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility exceeds -18, outdoor recreation substitutes for indoor retail activity, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: When PARKS exceeds -18, the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES recovery above -52 signals a return to office-based routines that increases weekday retail footfall, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES stays above -52 but the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remaining above 13.5 indicates persistent stay-at-home behavior that reduces retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays above 13.5 but the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Joint weekly improvement in TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM signals normalized mobility, which immediately lifts retail-and-recreation activity over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM both improve week-on-week
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM both improve week-on-week, the next 7-day mean RETAIL_REC is not higher than the prior 7-day mean.
